description: Uploads a file to a draft order: an energy bill or Heizkostenabrechnung (rechnung) or a photo (street side, heating, type plate). JPG, PNG, WebP or PDF as base64, at most 10 MB, 20 files per order. Bills are read and compared with the entered consumption after the customer has ordered; the Energieberater checks the photos. Usually the customer takes the photos on our page after the confirmation email. Orders nothing.

content_base64.description: the file, base64-encoded: JPG, PNG, WebP or PDF, at most 10 MB

filename.description: the file's name, for your reference

kind.description: rechnung (energy bill or Heizkostenabrechnung), fassade_strasse (photo of the street side), fassade_garten, heizung (photo of the boiler or heat pump), typenschild (photo of its type plate) or sonstiges

order_token.description: the order_token start_order returned; it opens only this order, keep it private

name: add_document
title: Upload a bill or photo
